summary: Restore the edition’s bridling verb zäumte.
rationale: Supplied 65/473 explicitly has sattelte und zäumte; zämte would misleadingly suggest taming rather than fitting the horse’s equipment.

summary: Correct zämte to zäumte in the horse-saddling passage
rationale: The edition explicitly reads sattelte und zäumte es. Zämte is neither the intended verb zäumen nor the correct preterite of zähmen.

summary: The token confirms II 1 tadellos zurecht machen in a sequence of saddling, bridling and tightening straps. It expresses complete/careful preparation, not a separately established technical grooming sense.
The prepared horse is recoverable from the preceding u səsyayḏe and is not repeated as an object of mtakazle. The l-series ending is the 3sg.m actor.
The full scene is already cited; only the demonstrated translation error is corrected. Kurdish derivation and base forms remain inherited.
Does mtakəz apply to careful preparation of objects beyond horses/equipment? This single token does not establish its broader participant range.
